about: AI-generated faces with known conditions, for face_fixtures.browser.test.ts. 'prompt' is what the generator was asked for; 'shows' is what the image really shows, checked by eye; 'generatorMismatch' lists where they differ. 'expect' holds the emotion label and bands [min, max]: faceWidth and centerX in image-width ratio, angles in degrees, emotions 0..1 (normalized). 'knownIssues' names expectations that fail today, with why.

fixtures.prompt: Portrait photo, woman's face filling 80% of frame, extremely close to camera, soft natural daylight from window on left, minimalist cream-colored wall background, shallow depth of field, high detail face, looking directly at camera, neutral expression, fair skin tone, short dark hair, professional photography style, 4k quality
fixtures.shows: frontal, small closed-mouth smile, face ~40% of the frame
generatorMismatch: face fills ~40% of the frame, not 80%
a small smile, not a neutral expression

fixtures.prompt: Close-up portrait, man's face very close to camera taking 75% of frame, dramatic side lighting from right, dimly lit room with warm lamp light, dark wooden bookshelf visible in blurred background, medium close-up shot, direct eye contact, slight smile, dark skin tone, short cropped hair, beard stubble, cinematic lighting, portrait photography, 4k
fixtures.shows: close-up in dim light, slight smile, the right side of the face out of the frame (happy reads right at the emotion threshold, so the label is not asserted)
generatorMismatch: the face is cut off at the right edge

fixtures.prompt: Standard portrait, woman's face at normal distance (head and shoulders visible), soft overcast daylight from window, modern living room with beige sofa and plants in background, natural shoulder-level shot, looking at camera, relaxed smile, medium skin tone, shoulder-length brown hair, casual clothing visible, professional portrait style, good lighting throughout
fixtures.shows: broad smile with teeth, eyes on the camera, head turned to one side
generatorMismatch: a broad smile with teeth rather than a relaxed one
the head is turned (the gaze is on the camera)
